objective: Retire member-facing Claim All and synthetic claim-all client compatibility; restore protected manual per-category claims after verified activities, with shared safe optional interstitial opportunities after each successful group settlement. Approved public rank-prestige experience and cosmetic rollouts remain separate future scopes.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only GitHub canonical MAIN SHA 9aed7d6ad8b6d0ad80aa71daaf66962e9d49de04 on 2026-11-24; live MAIN database confirms public.claim_my_buklod_reward_group_v1 has authenticated user lock, idempotent pending-ledger transition, balance, rank history and pending counter; existing Points UI had Claim All as its sole action. Exact installed production OTA, RC APK and AdMob device fill were not verified. No production migration/release authorized.
chosenApproach: Use the already deployed atomic per-group RPC for one manual claim per category; disable during in-flight request with ref guard; update only claimed group and account-scoped cache; server-confirmed points result before optional shared-controller interstitial; keep global consent/multi-action/cooldown/no-fill protections. Remove synthetic Claim All from client API only, preserving legacy server compatibility with installed clients.
selectionRationale: Avoid a new database mutation or per-ledger RPC and its rollout risks; group claims create independent intentional claim opportunities without AdMob's disallowed ad-on-every-action implementation. Maintain existing reward events, balances, rank crossing, earned points, and noncash economy.
alternativeApproaches: Force an interstitial after every claim: rejected by Google AdMob/Play ads policies; must honor existing cadence and user safety.
Revoke server Claim All immediately: rejected because older production clients still require compatibility; defer server deprecation until client uptake.
Auto-claim verified points: rejected by owner; all credits remain explicitly manually claimed.
Add new per-ledger RPC without schema review: rejected for this isolated release; reuse live validated group transaction.
preserveBehaviors: No automatic earning into lifetime or available until explicit manual claim; pending ledger stays durable.
Keep server-verified, account-scoped atomic transactions, idempotent retries, rank history, month/weekly rankings, Character XP and current rewards.
Do not rewrite historical credits, old ledger rows, existing rules or payout/AdMob financial accounting.
Keep current native AdMob unit, placements, consent, remote kill switch, two-action minimum, full-screen cooldown, prewarm and no-fill recovery.
Preserve claims while ads unavailable or failed; a successful claim never depends on an ad view or reward video.
Preserve History deep links, profile/points navigation, Celebration animation, sound/haptics and dark mode/Reduce Motion.
No Android native dependency, runtime/version, staging, or production OTA changes.
acceptanceChecks: No Claim All button, event identifier or synthetic Claim All loading path in the new client.
Each category exposes one active manual Claim action; only that group's server-confirmed balance moves on success.
Rapid double taps create one RPC only, with no duplicate points or ads; zero-point idempotent replies refresh only.
Claim success triggers flying-stars sound/haptics, correct rank-up and optional ad after settlement; no-fill or ad errors do not block points.
Timed-out or uncertain network response does not automatically re-issue claim mutation; bounded refresh reconciles before another manual action.
All existing ad/nav release gates, tests and native/production verification remain mandatory; no direct production OTA.
